teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.note: Still No. 1 at +6.9 points, even with a 0.4 dip after injuries. They've won 3 straight, the latest a 40-23 road win over the Titans, and the Giants are next as 8.5-point favorites.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.note: Up two spots to No. 2 after a 34-6 win at Arizona, their fourth in a row. The offense (+2.5 points) carries them, and the model likes them 2.2 points more than the betting market does.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.note: The 49ers slip to No. 3 despite beating Dallas 46-40 on the road and improving 0.6 points. At 8-1 with a +3.9 offense, they face the Vikings on a neutral field as 3.5-point favorites.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.note: Detroit jumps four spots to No. 4 behind a 35-10 win over New England, its fifth straight. The offense is +2.6 points, and the model is 2.8 points higher on them than Vegas.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.note: Five straight wins, the latest 38-18 over Pittsburgh, move the Bengals up two to No. 5. The offense is +2.7 points, and the defense at -0.6 is the one soft spot.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.note: Buffalo is 8-1 with the top strength of record, yet falls three spots to No. 6 as injuries cost them 1.1 points. Miami, favored against by 14.1, is up next.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.note: Seattle beat the Raiders 21-13 but drops two spots to No. 7 because the quarterback situation cost 1.4 points. The defense (+1.8 points) is doing the work, and the 49ers are next.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.note: Chicago sat out this week on a bye and still slid two spots to No. 8 at +3.6 points. Four straight wins at 7-2 and the Saints at home as 12.9-point favorites.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.note: The biggest riser in the top ten, up six to No. 9 after a 30-10 win over Green Bay. The defense is +2.3 points, the offense is -2.0, and they now visit San Francisco as 3.5-point underdogs.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.note: A 35-13 win in Atlanta still comes with a one-spot drop to No. 10, since injuries cost 1.0 points. The model is 2.5 points lower on them than the market.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.note: Denver used the bye to hold at No. 11, 7-2 with five straight wins. The point differential is only 12, though, and the Raiders come to town as 12.2-point underdogs.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.note: At 3-6, Tampa Bay still rates +1.7 points and sits at No. 12 after a bye. The defense is +1.6, the offense -1.0, and they visit Detroit as 5.2-point underdogs.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.note: A 30-10 home loss to Minnesota drops Green Bay one spot to No. 13. Their point differential is just 5, and the Rams are next with Green Bay a 6.8-point underdog.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.note: Houston is 3-6 after a 27-24 loss at Cleveland, yet moves up two to No. 14 because injuries added 2.4 points. The model is 3.2 points lower on them than Vegas.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.note: Getting beaten 35-10 by Detroit sends New England down two to No. 15 at 5-5. The offense lost 0.5 points, and the Chargers are next with the Patriots favored by 3.5.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.note: The Steelers lost 38-18 at Cincinnati and fell two spots to No. 16, with a rating drop of 1.0 points. At 6-3 they visit Philadelphia as 5.0-point favorites.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.note: A 24-21 win over the Giants lifts Washington one spot to No. 17 at 3-5-1. The defense is the problem at -0.9 points, and the Bengals visit next.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.note: Carolina edged the Saints 20-17 on the road and ticks up to No. 18 at 4-5. The model has them as 8.2-point favorites at home against Baltimore.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.note: Dallas lost a 46-40 shootout to San Francisco and falls two to No. 19. The defense is -2.1 points, and injuries cost them 2.0 points this week.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.note: Three straight losses, the latest 35-13 to Kansas City, leave Atlanta 3-7 at No. 20. The offense is -2.1 points, and the model is 2.9 points lower than Vegas on them.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.note: The Giants are 5-3-1 but rate -3.5 points after a 24-21 home loss to Washington. They hold at No. 21 and host Jacksonville as 8.5-point underdogs.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.note: Cleveland climbs three to No. 22 after beating Houston 27-24, and they're 6-4. The offense is still -2.4 points, the weakest piece, but the Raiders are next at home.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.note: The Colts beat Miami 24-22 but slip a spot to No. 23, as the quarterback situation cost 1.8 points. They're 3-7 and slight 0.9-point favorites against the Giants.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.note: At 1-8, the Chargers still beat Baltimore 23-20 on the road and rise two to No. 24. The offense is -2.9 points, and the model is 3.6 points lower than Vegas.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.note: New York has lost 5 straight, the last a 31-12 home defeat to Buffalo, and drops two to No. 25. The 2-8 Jets visit the Chargers as 2.0-point underdogs.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.note: Arizona lost 34-6 to the Rams, and the quarterback situation cost 1.1 points. They still move up a spot to No. 26 at -7.0 points, with the Chiefs next.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.note: Tennessee jumps five spots to No. 27 despite a 40-23 loss to Jacksonville, because injuries added 2.6 points. At 1-8, they visit Dallas as 6.8-point underdogs.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.note: New Orleans lost 20-17 to Carolina at home and holds at No. 28. Injuries cost them 3.0 points this week, and the model is 4.7 points lower than Vegas.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.note: Philadelphia has lost 7 straight and sits at No. 29 after a bye. The quarterback situation puts them 3.5 points below normal, and the Steelers visit as 5.0-point favorites.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.note: Miami is 1-8 after a 24-22 loss to Indianapolis, yet rises one spot to No. 30. They've lost 3 straight and visit Buffalo as 14.1-point underdogs.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.note: The Raiders fell 21-13 to Seattle and drop to No. 31. Their quarterback situation sits 3.6 points below usual, and they're 12.2-point underdogs at Denver.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.note: Baltimore plunges eight spots to last at -8.1 points, losing 23-20 to the Chargers. The quarterback situation cost 2.3 points and the Ravens have lost 5 straight.
